thread:
maya: Hey folks — quick onboarding question: where do I get the official doc templates (runbooks, 1:1, OKR page)? I can see pages but can't duplicate them.
devex-bot: Heads up: check that you're in the Redwood workspace and that the page isn't view-only. If Duplicate is greyed out, it might be restricted. You can request access from the page owner.
maya: I'm in the right workspace. On desktop the page shows but Duplicate is disabled and I don't see an owner field.
alex: That usually means the template is in a restricted area or it's a database template. Tagging @sasha and @people-ops to help — they own the onboarding templates.
people-ops: Hi Maya! Our templates live in People Ops > Templates (1:1, new hire checklist) and Company Home > Templates (runbooks, team playbooks). Which exact templates are you trying to copy?
maya: Incident runbook and the 1:1 + goals page.
juan: For incident runbooks, there's often a canonical database in Company Home > Eng > Runbooks. Instead of duplicating the page, you may need to create a new entry in that database using the built-in template: New -> choose "Incident runbook (template)". Duplicating works for standalone pages, not DB templates.
maya: Ah ok that explains the runbook. But the 1:1 is a standalone page and still no Duplicate.
sasha: @maya I just checked permissions and the 1:1 starter was accidentally set to "Can view" for new accounts. I changed it to "Can edit" for you. Try refreshing.
maya: Refresh done, Duplicate is available now. Thanks! Couple of extra questions: 1) Where should I move duplicates for team runbooks? 2) How do I find the page owner in future?
alex: Best practice: operational runbooks stay in the shared eng-runbooks space (visible to eng-oncall). Personal things like your 1:1 notes go in your Private workspace or People Ops > Personal > 1:1s and then share a view with your manager if needed.
people-ops: For owner info, hover near the title — there should be an "Owner" property in the page header if the doc is managed. If it's empty, add a small "Doc owner: <name>" block at the top and ping the owning channel to confirm.
juan: And another tip: add a tiny front-matter block on team docs with fields: Owner, Last updated, How to duplicate. It saves a lot of back-and-forth during onboarding.
maya: Great idea. I'll duplicate and move the runbook to eng-runbooks and keep my 1:1 in Private. I'll add the doc-meta block and tag the owner.
sasha: If you can't find the owner later, ping #devex or the channel for that area (eng, product, people-ops) and include the page link.
maya: Perfect. Appreciate the help :thumbsup:
alex: Welcome aboard Maya! Ping us anytime with docs quirks.
maya: Will do — thanks everyone :)
